interests.title: Race interests
interests.intro: Choose which upcoming races to suggest. Matching races from public calendars show up in your diary.
interests.unavailable: Race proposals are not available right now.
interests.notConfigured: You have not saved any interests yet. These are the suggested defaults; save them to start seeing proposals.

what.ultraHint: Ultra also matches any race longer than a marathon.

where.hint: Voivodeships and a place with a radius both count: a race matches if either one fits. With neither, races from all of Poland match.
where.placeHint: Pick a place on the map, then set how far from it a race may be.
where.mapLabel: Preview of the search area on a map

distance.hint: A race matches if one of its distances falls in this range. Leave a field empty for no limit.

keywords.label: Keywords (optional)
keywords.hint: Up to 5 words; a race must contain all of them in its name or place.

show.label: Show proposals in the diary
show.hint: Proposals appear in the calendar as dotted flag markers.

validation.kindsRequired: Select at least one kind of race.
validation.centerNameLength: The place name can have at most 200 characters.
validation.radiusRequired: Enter a radius for the chosen place.
validation.radiusRange: Enter a radius from 5 to 300 km.
validation.distanceRange: Enter a distance from 1 to 250 km.
validation.distanceOrder: The longest distance must not be shorter than the shortest.
validation.keywordsLength: Keywords can have at most 100 characters.

attribution.disclaimer: Race facts come from public calendars; always check the organiser's page.
